$comment: kalfa-fleet configuration. The pm2 scheduler (bin/scheduler.mjs) reloads this every tick, so edits take effect within 60s without a restart. KILLSWITCH file in this directory stops everything. answer_watcher: detects owner verdicts autonomously — roles with auto_ack get an immediate CLI ack (trivial consumers); scheduled roles get their headless run spawned to act on the verdict. Times are Asia/Jerusalem, days 0=Sunday (Israel work week Sun-Thu = '0-4').

smoke-test-t2.$comment: enabled:true here does NOT mean it runs on its own — run-role.sh's enabled-check blocks even manual invocation when false, so this must stay true. What actually keeps it manual-only is the empty schedule AND empty reactive array below: the scheduler has nothing to match against either way, so it never self-spawns. Trigger by hand (bash .claude/fleet/bin/run-role.sh smoke-test-t2) after any change to guard-tier2.sh or tier2.settings.json — nothing else in the fleet tests Tier-2's hook, which is exactly why the .env-parity bug survived undetected until 2026-07-30.

roles.$support_drafter_comment: ACTIVE (corrected 2026-08-25 — this comment previously said 'Kept enabled:false' after the role was already flipped to enabled:true; the draft_reply length-cap migration it was waiting on, 20260726093000_contact_messages_draft_reply_length.sql, shipped 2026-07-26). contact_messages is the free-text inquiry table. Role reads status='new', draft_reply IS NULL rows (id/topic/message only — no name/email/phone) and writes a proposed reply to draft_reply via `npm run fleet:agent -- draft-reply --id --body` (the CLI's only customer-table write; idempotent on the IS NULL guard). It NEVER emails — a human reviews/sends the draft in /admin/contacts. Prompt: roles/support-drafter.md. KNOWN GAP (see docs/inquiry-email-threading-fix-plan-2026-08-25.md §6): the trigger query never matches status='reopened', so a reopened inquiry is silently never drafted for.
roles.$main_comment: Role=main is spawned via THREE distinct paths, all reactive — NO schedule. (1) answer-watcher (scheduler.mjs answerWatcherTick): spawns whenever any fleet_requests row assigned role=main receives an owner verdict (poll's `verdicts` bucket) — runs independently of the `reactive` array below, gated only by enabled + non-auto_ack. Covers agent-filed requests, including another role's `handoff --to main` (buildHandoffRequest never sets payload.origin, so a handoff row always waits here for an explicit owner answer — it never routes through path 2). Authorization is the per-request answer; closes via the CLI complete verb (push + Slack thread + green badge), no ack except denied. (2) owner_direct_request (inquiry-watcher trigger, scheduler.mjs TRIGGERS): spawns while a fleet_requests row assigned role=main with payload.origin='owner' is still pending (poll's `inbox` bucket) — created when the owner opens a new conversation targeting main directly from /admin/fleet's compose form (fleet_owner_request RPC), bypassing handoff entirely. (3) goal_due (inquiry-watcher trigger): spawns when a fleet_goals row assigned role=main comes due; authorization is the goal body itself; closes via goal-progress/goal-close, never complete/ack. Its only Tier-2 power on any path is supabase db query (guard-tier2.sh).
roles.$creative_comment: Creative fleet — all draft-only (report tier). brand-director/content-seo-strategist/social-manager/creative-producer are enabled — owner confirmed 2026-07-30 that this was intentional, not a leftover from testing. This comment previously said 'kept disabled until BRAND.md is owner-approved'; that no longer describes the config (BRAND.md §8 still carries a few open owner tasks — positioning line, palette/logo, second avatar, social proof — but the owner decided these don't block operation; every creative role already reads BRAND.md as-is and works within what exists today). brand-director is the editor-in-chief gate every other creative draft passes through. lifecycle-copywriter is separately BLOCKED for a different, unrelated reason: the user_settings.marketing_updates consent column it depends on does not exist in the live schema yet (see lifecycle-copywriter.md's own header warning) — not a BRAND.md question. marketing-content is disabled pending a separate owner call on whether to run a PR/earned-media role at all (see marketing-content.md's own header).
roles.$callback_triage_comment: Reads the free text of a NEW callback request and extracts ONLY structured availability constraints (not-before / not-after / excluded dates) for the deterministic scheduler. Writes through two narrow CLI verbs (triage-claim / triage-finish) that wrap SECURITY DEFINER RPCs; the fence, lease, attempt ceiling and state machine all live in the database. It never picks a time, never writes to the calendar, and never reads the caller's name or phone. Prompt: roles/callback-triage.md. timeout_minutes is 10 ON PURPOSE — the claim lease is 30 minutes, and a role allowed to run as long as its lease (which is what the 30 its neighbours use would mean) has its work reclaimed mid-run and duplicated. Disabled until the owner enables it.
roles.$fleet_maintainer_comment: Self-maintenance role for the FLEET's own code/prompts/config/docs (NOT the KALFA app). Tier 2 always — even its one write path (housekeeping-pr) runs git/gh as trusted server-side code inside fleet-agent-cli.ts, never as a Bash-tool grant to this role. Ships enabled:false; owner flips after reviewing the role prompt + known-issues.json catalog (see plans/fleet-maintenance-capability-plan.md §7 for the staged rollout).
